Eye Strain Timer (20-20-20)

A 20-20-20 rule timer for screen workers: work 20 minutes, then rest your eyes 20 seconds looking 20 feet away.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start to begin a 20-minute focus block.
  2. When it ends, look at something 20 feet away for the 20-second rest.
  3. The cycle repeats automatically; completed breaks are counted.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the 20-20-20 rule?

Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet (6 m) away for 20 seconds. It relaxes the focusing muscle and reminds you to blink.

Can I change the 20-minute interval?

Yes — use the focus-length field if your workflow needs 25 or 30 minute blocks. The 20-second rest stays per the rule.

Does this replace eye drops or glasses?

No. It reduces strain but persistent dryness, headaches or blurred vision deserve an eye exam.
